actual_label: 2015–19 actual (this dataset): wind + solar share of new capacity added
target_2030_label: IEA Net Zero pathway: renewables' share of total electricity generation needed by 2030
target_2050_label: IEA Net Zero pathway: renewables' share of total electricity generation needed by 2050
source: International Energy Agency, Net Zero by 2050: A Roadmap for the Global Energy Sector (2021) and World Energy Outlook 2020 — renewables' share of global electricity generation rises from 27% (2019) to roughly 60% (2030) and roughly 90% (2050) in the IEA's Net Zero Emissions Scenario. Compared here against this dataset's wind+solar share of newly added capacity, which is a related but not identical metric: all renewables vs. wind+solar only, and share of total generation vs. share of new capacity additions.
